sources.label: 🧩 Android patches for Morphe: AMOLED themes, ad removal and premium unlocks for
sources.author: hxreborn
patch_list: Stops sending usage events, the cloned app list and the private browser's search and download history to the developer, and disables Firebase Analytics.
Opens the Google Account settings from Manage Google account.
Removes splash, banner, native and interstitial ads, including the ad shown when a cloned app opens, and the ad consent form.
Unlocks VIP: multiple copies of each app, batch cloning, bubble mode, custom themes and no ads. Removes the 50% off offer and the Free VIP, Renew VIP and Get F-Code entries.
